SELECT cgca.id AS id, cgca.is_mandatory AS is_mandatory, cgca.deadline AS deadline, cgca.created_date AS created_date, cgca.modified_date AS modified_date, , ,
FROM gc_content_group_course_assignment cgca JOIN gc_subject s ON cgca.course_id = s.id JOIN gc_access a ON cgca.access_id = a.id JOIN gc_user u ON cgca.user_id = u.id JOIN gc_user_info ui ON u.info_id = ui.id LEFT JOIN sys_file sfs ON sfs.ID = s.sub_img_id LEFT JOIN sys_file sfui ON sfui.ID = ui.avatar_file_id WHERE cgca.access_id = #{contentGroupId}
